meta.title: Shipment dispatch
meta.subtitle: example-app · fixture
meta.question: How does a shipment get created and dispatched?

curation.reason: not on the path the question asks about

functions.name: POST /orders/:id/shipments
functions.summary: Entry point for creating a shipment.

modules.name: Web.ShipmentsController
modules.summary: Translates HTTP into the create-shipment action and renders the result.

functions.name: create/2
functions.summary: Authorizes, then delegates to Actions.CreateShipment — no business logic here.

modules.name: Actions.CreateShipment
modules.summary: The single seam every shipment creation goes through, UI or API.

functions.name: run/2
functions.summary: Validates, persists the shipment, and schedules label jobs in one transaction so concurrent submits can't double-book the carrier.

functions.name: validate/1
functions.summary: Rejects shipments for orders with no packable items.

modules.name: Manifest
modules.summary: Owns parcel planning: what goes in which box, and when it leaves.

functions.name: preview/1
functions.summary: Dry-run of the parcel split, used by the UI before committing.

functions.name: plan/2
functions.summary: Splits the shipment into parcels and enqueues a label job for each.

functions.name: cancel/1
functions.summary: Stops parcels that haven't shipped; already-handed-off ones are left alone.

modules.name: Workers.LabelPrinter
modules.summary: Buys and prints one parcel's label; retried by the job queue on failure.

functions.name: perform/1
functions.summary: Loads the parcel, buys the label, records the outcome.

modules.name: Store.Shipments
modules.summary: Persistence for shipments and their parcels.

functions.name: get/1
functions.summary: Fetches a shipment with its parcels.
